messages:
jamie: Quick ping — PR 25678 is ready for review. It touches routing/batching (runtime), autoscaler hints (infra), and a small KMS rotation hook (security). Need runtime + infra + security eyes before tomorrow's merge window. https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/25678 :eyes:

sasha: Looking now. main changes to runtime are in continuous_batcher.go and kv_cache.go — any perf numbers for 2x batch sizes?

jamie: basic perf run attached in PR comments — +18% token/sec at 2x average seq, latency p95 increase ~30ms. KV cache change is a fallthrough refactor, not a functional change. cc @sasha for perf sanity check.

oliver: FYI infra: autoscaler config change in the helm chart? I see an annotation in manifests/scale.yaml — does this rely on the new eviction signal? If so need cluster-ops approval for the flag.

jamie: correct — it's opt-in behind featureFlag.evictionBoost. I added a small helm values snippet in the PR:```yamlfeatureFlags:  evictBoost: true  autoscaler:    targetCPU: 65```

oliver: ok can you paste the exact annotation you added so I can run through cluster-ops checklist?

jamie: annotation is `redwood.com/eviction-priority: "batching-hint"` — added to Deployment template. Also added a note that it's only considered when pod has batching-aware=true.

maya: Security here — KMS rotation hook: what principal/key scope? Is this using customer-managed key or our service key? Need to confirm KMS IAM bindings and whether rotation happens in control plane or node agent. Also want a short threat-outline.

jamie: it's customer-managed (CMK) by default, with fallback to service key if not set. Rotation is triggered by control plane webhook, not on-node. Threat outline in PR description (short): potential privilege escalation if webhook token leaked -> mitigated by signed webhook + short-lived tokens + KMS audit logging enabled.

maya: please add the KMS IAM snippet and webhook signing verification steps to the PR, then I can give a formal +1.

ravi: Platform question — canary policy: who owns the canary route? PR mentions auto-fallback to smaller model on errors; need an owner to monitor the canary for 1h post-merge.

jamie: assigning @ravi as canary owner in PR description, will add runbook alerting rule to Console dashboards (latency > 2x baseline or error rate > 0.5%).

sasha: runtime: quick note — the KV cache refactor removed one mutex in hot path, can you add a microbenchmark and include p95/p50 in PR? I can eyeball but prefer numbers.

jamie: will add microbench results in the thread by EOD.

deploy-bot: CI passed — all checks green except flaky-test-suite (re-run suggested). Merge window slot available 2023-11-17 03:00 UTC (4h).

oliver: I can fast-track cluster-ops review if you pin the helm values to the PR and add the annotation check in the manifest.

maya: once KMS snippet in PR, I can review quickly.

ravi: I can take canary monitoring for the 1h window.

jamie: thanks all. TL;DR: next steps for merge: (1) jamie adds KMS IAM snippet + webhook signing steps (2) jamie posts microbench numbers (3) oliver okays cluster-ops checklist (4) maya signoff on KMS (5) ravi owns canary. Please drop :thumbsup: here if you can sign by 20:00 PT today so we can merge in the 03:00 UTC slot.

sasha: :+1: will add bench results by 18:30 PT.

oliver: :eyes: replying in PR, can fast-track.

maya: :thumbsup: will review once snippet added.

ravi: :+1: can on-call for the hour after merge.

jamie: great — thanks everyone. I updated the PR with the KMS snippet and webhook signing steps. pinging here once more for final thumbs before I queue the merge.
